bg.$description: Background behind the player and transcript link.

bg-image.$description: Optional image painted over the player background.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter applied to the player, off by default.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the player panel.

progress-bg.$description: Colour of the elapsed timeline and seek thumb.

title-family.$description: Font family of the recording title.

speed-radius.$description: Corner radius of the playback speed button.
